notes.title: Road To Place Official Release Date
notes.content:
Road to place will be officially releasing on march 10th 2023 this is our 5th steam release and I hope you enjoy it. Pricing is still being discussed but it will be in line with our other games we have out. Btw if you want to check out some early gameplay. Stellar Dakota made an excellent video on the game that will show you everything you need to know about it. Also there is a chance we may release early so make sure to wishlist RTP just in case :D
[previewyoutube=j87YoYt2GVI;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you and have a great day

-Lunatic
